notes.title: Added How To Play
notes.content:
Added a brief description of how to play the game.
Added screen and operation descriptions, as well as the trailer available on the Steam store, which can be viewed in-game.

notes.title: A new stage, "Subspace," has been added!
notes.content:
A new stage "Subspace" has been added!
Most of the enemies are randomly generated, making this stage playable over and over again.
The BGM is canon code, and only in this stage, allies increase automatically regardless of mana and do not retreat when hit by bullets.

Other modifications:
* Slight modification of the UI.
* Fixed a bug that the performance of frequently attacked allies (violins, etc.) would stop midway through the performance.
* Save data will be lost again this time. During early access, I think it will disappear with every update. Sorry.

Memo:
The update interval has been somewhat long. The next one may be just as long. We hope you will be patient.

notes.title: Slightly lighter processing. Support for Chinese language
notes.content:
Some parts of the process have been made a little lighter.
Added Chinese language support.

notes.title: Gamepad is now supported.
notes.content:
v0.9.0.1 was created.
- Gamepad is now supported.
- Added key configurations to the options screen.
- Adjusted the volume of some sound effects.
- Fixed a bug that the game did not save after clearing a stage only after starting the game for the first time.
